# Support

Use the right channel so maintainers can respond efficiently:

- **Usage questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/zoxilsi/studio/discussions)
- **Reproducible bugs:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zoxilsi/studio/issues/new/choose)
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow [the security policy](SECURITY.md)

This is a community-maintained project. Response times are best effort.
